column1: # The crossings ledger — one line per public release, appended by
# scripts/release/sign-and-push.sh so a tired human never types it again.
# A public commit carries exactly one provenance trailer, `Projected-From`, so
# the mapping is already recorded IN the public history. This file is the same
# mapping read from the development side, where the dev SHA is the key you
# actually have in hand. The archive ref refs/cosmon/crossings/v<version> pins
# the same dev SHA as an object, so it survives even if this file is edited.
